objective: Make coverage threshold enforcement and default frontend test credit truthful.
non_goals: Do not lower coverage thresholds to obtain green.
Do not delete historical evidence; remove it only from default current-product credit.
Do not touch Rust, Tauri, external providers, Keychain or product data.
invariant: Missing, malformed, zero-collection, below-threshold, forbidden-credit and test-ID-drift evidence fails; valid evidence passes; default credited tests represent current product surfaces only.
minimal_fix_contract: Use one deterministic parser/checker authority and an explicit current-test include/exclude contract; do not add a second coverage truth.
old_path_deletion_contract: Remove the inline false-green parser when the single checker replaces it; retired tests remain historical but lose default credit.
acceptance_criteria: All four named coverage counterexamples exit nonzero for the stated reason.
All three named selection counterexamples exit nonzero for the stated reason.
A valid coverage artifact passes the same checker.
Default credited test IDs/count exclude retired Stage1, Step6, dev-harness and tauriDev-dependent evidence while retaining current tauri wrapper tests.
Production build and absence guard remain green.
stop_conditions: Frozen source map or canonical owner is false.
A write is required outside allowed_touched_paths.
An expected-absent object would be recreated.
A required RED cannot be made to fail for the stated reason.
A closure-candidate proof has not failed before conditional implementation.
The same root cause has failed three implementation attempts.
The hard-stop size budget is exceeded; split the slice or stop for a successor Program.
External action or durable write needs authority not present in the packet.
ledger_update_contract: Integrator records R3-N010/R3-N020 evidence and W0 outcome at the exact reviewed head; implementation Agent does not grant closure.
handoff_contract: Return changed paths, raw RED/positive outputs, exact head SHA, residual UNKNOWN and independent challenge result.
